anatomical_target.reference: Bácskai et al. (2014) Brain Struct Funct 219:603–621
anatomical_target.species_strain: Mus musculus, adult C57BL/6J and C57BL/6J-ChAT-EGFP (20-25 g, 8-12 weeks)
anatomical_target.segments: L4 and L5 dorsolateral motor column
anatomical_target.mapping_assumption: Affine rank-order mapping into [5600, 7900] um (position and longitudinal spread both change; distribution within range is an experimental assumption)

experimental_conditions.B: Coordinate-only relocation control (identical W and rates; only coordinates change)
experimental_conditions.C: Same-location reconstruction control (rebuilt at baseline location using author InstantiateNetwork)
experimental_conditions.D: Relocated TA with rebuilt connections (rebuilt at L4-L5 location using author InstantiateNetwork and matched seeds)

primary_causal_comparison: Condition C vs Condition D isolates spatial relocation with zero stochastic rewiring confounding.
